title: GetOdds sports odds and player props

apiKey.title: GetOdds API key
apiKey.description: Your own key. Free (1,000 requests a day, no card): https://getoddsapi.com/sign-up?utm_source=apify&utm_medium=actor&utm_campaign=getodds-scraper. Leave empty to read the keyless sample: DraftKings game lines from the sandbox, or the public player props board.

marketType.title: Market type
marketType.description: Player props: each book's line and over/under price per player and stat. Game lines: moneyline, spread and total per game and book.
enumTitles: Player props: every book's line and over/under price per player and stat
Game lines: moneyline, spread and total per game and book

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Player props cover NBA, NFL, NHL, NCAAF and NCAAB.

books.title: Books
books.description: Leave empty for every book. Game lines are read from DraftKings, FanDuel, Pinnacle and Novig; books your key has no grant for are skipped with a log line.

player.title: Player
player.description: Player props only. Name or part of it, for example tatum.

stat.title: Stat
stat.description: Player props only. For example points, rebounds, assists, threes, pra, passing_yards, rushing_yards, receiving_yards, receptions, shots_on_goal.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many rows. Each API page (up to 200 props or markets) costs one request on your own GetOdds plan.
